notes.title: Update 3!
notes.notes:
The game should stop freezing with certain gamepads. Xbox and PlayStation controllers generally worked fine, but those cheaper, off-brand ones sometimes had issues sending the same signals as the higher-end controllers. Hopefully I've worked around this as best as possible. Not sure how many people were affected by it, but I've seen it happen a few times. 

Also, Rogue mode had a few issues with generating random levels. Sometimes the game would mess up which player is which and the camera would zoom out way too far. Super unlikely given how many possible outcomes there are, but again, it happened to me while testing it so let's see how that goes. 

Thanks again,
 - Daniel.

notes.title: Controller Crash Update
notes.notes:
Found the error that causes the game to crash when four people join.

I can't believe I overlooked something that simple. It's always the little things, you know? 

I'm almost certain this will fix the issue, but if it's still doing it, let me know and I'll do some more digging around. Thanks

 - Daniel

notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I appreciate all the kind words and reviews:)

With everyone playing it, it really opens your eyes to any issues that are present in the game. Thus, I present to you: Update #1:


    Updated graphical system/options to help increase frame-rate on older machines.
    Updated a glitch that prevented some users from unlocking certain achievements.
    (Hopefully) Fixed an error that crashed the game when joining the lobby with certain gamepads.


Thanks again, everyone.

 - Daniel
